look_here_first: Tall wetland sedge with broad glaucous leaves and a dense cylindrical inflorescence with long-beaked perigynia.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Carex sedges have sheathing leaves and perigynia enclosing the fruits.

lookalikes.differences: Much denser and wetter-site than C. blanda, C. edwardsiana, or C. planostachys.
